outcome: Give Consulting / SI teams a working Agentic Decision-Intelligence Accelerator capability on their own data — it compresses engagement discovery from weeks to days.
overview: Discovery is where consulting margin quietly disappears: senior people spend low-margin weeks assembling a picture of a client’s data before a single billable insight lands, and clients increasingly reject time-and-materials for accelerator-backed work. This accelerator mines a client’s structured records, documents and prior deliverables, then drafts narrative insight dashboards that consultants edit rather than author. Every narrative cites the source record, and nothing reaches the client without consultant review. A five-to-six week build on real or representative engagement data proves it inside one account, shortening time-to-first-insight, giving bid teams demonstrable IP, and turning billable hours into an asset the next engagement reuses.
